heroDescription: The framework governing selected Elleva ecosystem programs, operational conditions and associated risks.

programs.title: Elleva Pool
programs.description: Participation linked to applicable company results.

importantDisclosure.title: Important disclosure
importantDisclosure.description: Elleva programs involve operational, market, technology and other risks. No program described here guarantees income, profits, returns or preservation of capital.

sections.title: Purpose of this document
paragraphs: This document describes the general framework applicable to certain Elleva ecosystem programs and operational mechanisms.
These rules should be read together with the Elleva Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
Program conditions may vary according to the applicable product, account, jurisdiction, eligibility requirements and operational conditions.

sections.title: ProfitShare
paragraphs: ProfitShare is an Elleva ecosystem mechanism through which eligible users may participate in variable distributions associated with applicable operational and economic results.
ProfitShare is variable. It is not a fixed interest payment and does not constitute a guarantee of profit, return or preservation of capital.
Applicable distributions may depend on operational results, eligibility, account conditions, program rules and other factors applicable at the time.
Historical distributions do not establish a promise, forecast or guarantee of future distributions.

sections.title: Elleva Direct
paragraphs: Elleva Direct is an ecosystem development program through which eligible participants may receive benefits or distributions associated with qualifying activity within their eligible ecosystem structure.
The current program structure may include level-based distributions according to the official Elleva Direct rules.
Participation does not guarantee income, profits, financial results or advancement to any recognition level.
Participants may not make unauthorized, misleading or guaranteed claims regarding Elleva, its programs or potential results.

sections.title: Elleva Pool
paragraphs: Elleva Pool is an internal ecosystem mechanism connected to the economic performance of the company and applicable participant qualification criteria.
Under the applicable program structure, the Pool may allocate a defined portion of company gross profit to qualified participants.
Participation is subject to the applicable qualification rules and does not create a guarantee of any particular distribution.

sections.title: Operational conditions
paragraphs: Applicable minimums, maximums, fees, withdrawal conditions, processing periods, qualification requirements and other operational parameters may be displayed in the Elleva platform or applicable program documentation.
Current operational parameters may be updated as the infrastructure, programs, third-party providers or applicable requirements evolve.
Where a specific transaction or program presents applicable conditions before completion, those conditions govern the relevant activity.

sections.title: Risk
paragraphs: Participation in Elleva programs may involve financial, operational, technological and market risks.

sections.title: No guaranteed outcome
paragraphs: No Elleva program should be represented as a guaranteed income, guaranteed return or risk-free opportunity.
Participants must not represent historical results, examples, percentages or distributions as promises of future performance.

sections.title: Program changes
paragraphs: Elleva may modify, suspend or discontinue an ecosystem program or operational mechanism when reasonably necessary due to operational, technological, security, compliance, legal or business considerations.
Changes may be communicated through the platform, official documentation or other appropriate channels.

sections.title: Participant conduct
paragraphs: Participants are responsible for communicating accurate information about Elleva and its programs.
Participants must not promise financial results, fabricate performance, impersonate Elleva, alter official program conditions or make representations inconsistent with official Elleva materials.
